general_information.Pre-Requisite: Recommended to have knowledges of Digital Signal Processing (DGT301)
general_information.Description: The course covers the basic knowledge neccessary for transmitting and receiving information using today's communication technologies. It is the introduction to communication systems: analogue vs. digital communications, analogue modulation techniques (amplitude modulation, frequency modulation, phase modulation), broadcast radio and TV systems, source coding, communication channels (noise, bandwidth), signalling over bandlimited channels (matched filter, intersymbol interference (ISI), Nyquist criterion), binary digital modulation techniques (amplitude shift keying, frequency shift keying, phase shift keying). Topics covered: Introduction; Fourier Representation of Signals and Systems; Amplitude Modulation; Angle Modulation; Pulse Modulation: Transition from Analog to Digital Communications; Baseband Data Transmission; Digital Band-Pass Modulation Techniques; Random Signals and Noise; Noise in Analog Communications; Noise in Digital Communications; System and Noise Calculations
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. '- Student is responsible to do all exercises and assigments given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time. - Do progress tests at class. - Constantly follow announcements on intranet/CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.

assessments.Note: - 10% of total progress mark - The instructor should announce the appropriate deadline based on the syllabus. - The assignment is graded based on both the report and presentation

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Select one of following suggestions 1. Topic: "System and noise calculations" 2. Using Matlab to simulate modulation techniques
assessments.Grading Guide: - The assignment should be done in groups of 3 and given in slot 20 - The instructor give every group one problem to design simple communications systems - Reports should be contained link budget, noise, fading….and evaluation - Reports should be submitted before slot 27 - Presentation is required
